inputs.model.prompt:
[Style] Futuristic magical water observatory, 8K ultra-clear, Photorealistic, High-fashion Editorial, circular fountain platform, suspended liquid membranes, aurora color gradients, dreamlike sci-fi elegance, Unreal Engine 5 fluid simulation and atmospheric glow.

Protagonist note:
A female fashion model, mid-20s, editorial silhouette: shoulder-length auburn hair in loose waves, tall lean build, calm confident posture.

[Duration] 5 seconds.

[Scene] A circular observatory suspended above a dark luminous void; a ring-shaped fountain surrounds the platform; thin vertical water membranes hover like transparent walls, and the ceiling glows with aurora colors.

[00:00-00:02] Shot 1: Fountain ring.
Camera: medium-wide orbit around the circular platform; water ring and figure share the frame.
Action: She walks along the fountain rim; the thin water membranes around the platform shimmer with the ceiling colors.
Effect: The nearest water membranes begin to peel away from the fountain ring into soft liquid sheets that resemble miniature aurora walls.

[00:02-00:04] Shot 2: Membrane rise.
Camera: medium three-quarter on torso, the fountain rim, and nearby water curtain.
Action: She raises both hands slowly.
Effect: The liquid membranes peel fully away from the fountain ring and rise into tall aurora-tinted sheets, matching the observatory geometry.

[00:04-00:05] Shot 3: Observatory dissolve.
Camera: crane up into a top view of the circular space.
Action: She remains in the center while the sheets expand beyond her.
Effect: The fountain ring, floor circle, and hovering water walls all soften into luminous aurora washes, and the observatory disappears into a vast magical liquid sky.
